```{r setup-index, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source_path <- here::here("bike_geometry_project.R")
source(source_path)
```

Current number of bike models in the database: `r length(unique(geobike[, model]))`!

### Gravel Bike Finder Tools

These tools have filters for material, suspension correction, UDH compatibility, sliding dropout, handlebar (flat or drop), axle spacing, and maximum tire width.

[A table](qmd/gravel_class.qmd) of the classification of all gravel bike models in the database into Racy, Relaxed, and Rowdy categories

[A single plot](qmd/gravel_mds.qmd) that compares overall similarity of frame geometryamong gravel bikes, color coded by style

### Gravel Bike Specs Comparison Tools

[A table](qmd/test_bike_comparison.qmd) to compare up to three bikes on key frame geometry measures and frame specs.

### Gravel style tools

Plots to show which frame measures make

[Racy bikes racy!](qmd/what_makes_a_racy_bike_racy.qmd)

[Relaxed bikes relaxed!](qmd/what_makes_a_relaxed_bike_relaxed.qmd)

[Rowdy bikes rowdy!](qmd/what_makes_a_rowdy_bike_rowdy.qmd)

### A gallery of frame measures

The [Gravel Geometry](qmd/gravel_scatter.qmd) page contains interactive, 2D scatter plots of different pairs of frame geometry measures for all gravel bike models and frame sizes in the database.

### How does my bike frame geometry change if I add suspension?

See how your bike frame's [geometry changes with a suspension fork](qmd/gravel_sus_fork.qmd).

See how your bike frame's [relative similarity to other bikes changes with a suspension fork]( qmd/gravel_scatter_sus.qmd).

### A Tree Diagram of frame similarity

The [Gravel Tree](qmd/gravel_tree.qmd) page contains a tree diagram showing the relative similarity in frame geometry among all gravel bikes in the database and the clustering of the models into three major styles.
